text:
release-manager: Heads-up — RC cutoff in 45m (2067892790). We’re enabling a 30m grace window after cutoff for rollback/critical late merges only. Please follow the exception checklist below and ping me directly for approval.

release-manager: Exception checklist: 1) PR link, 2) one senior approver (not author), 3) green CI + test log, 4) changelog entry + short risk note, 5) roll-forward and rollback steps included.

alex: Okay — is the grace window absolute? wondering about long-running integration tests.

release-manager: grace window is strict to protect RC stability. long tests must be split or we need a focused hotfix PR. If you need an exception, include a short risk note and exact rollback commands.

maria: I have a small bugfix (PR #6032) that needs to go in — fixes tokenization edgecase for redwood/encoder. Tests pass locally but CI is flaky. can I request exception? @release-manager

devon: CI is failing on master for the gpu-inference tests — not related to maria's change but heads-up: failing tests might block merge until fixed.

ci-bot: [ci] build #1987 failed on branch "main" — pytest -k gpu_inference failed (2/27 tests). Logs: https://ci.internal/build/1987/log

maria: argh. i'm re-running the flaky job now. if it flakes again, i'll attach the failing test log and full repro.

alex: if the CI is the blocker, can we do a gated merge with a temporary bypass? don't want to open the floodgates.

jen: don’t bypass. If we allow bypass, we need at least two approvals and clear rollback steps. Also tag @oncall to confirm no infra coroutine issues.

oncall: I can monitor post-deploy for 1h if we get an exception approved. Need the rollback commands and a feature-flag toggle if possible.

maria: PR #6032: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/6032 — includes changelog entry at docs/changelog/2026-03-17.md and risk note. repro: docker run -e TEST_GPU=1 ./run_integration.sh --case token-edge. rollback: git revert -m 1 <merge-commit> then redeploy rc.

alex: quick sanity check from me once CI is green. if CI remains flaky, i can run the focused test on infra node-7 and attach logs.

devon: on infra node-7 i reproduced the failure — attaching snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 0.0 but got 1.2
tests/test_gpu_inference.py::test_kv_cache_consistency
```

jen: thanks. if that failure is orthogonal, we can still approve maria's change with extra monitoring, but we should gate the merge behind manual CI re-run success and @alex approval.

release-manager: Maria — please escalate: 1) re-run CI, 2) request @alex approval, 3) paste CI job link and the short rollback commands in this thread. If all boxes checked, I will approve the exception during the grace period.

maria: CI re-run succeeded: https://ci.internal/build/1990 — all tests green. @alex can you +1?

alex: +1 from me, reviewed diff, small and focused. I'm happy to be the senior approver. :thumbsup:

release-manager: Approved. Proceed to merge during the 30m grace window. Reminder: tag the changelog commit with `rc/2026-03-17` and notify ops. I'll schedule monitoring with @oncall.

deploy-bot: Freeze scheduled — RC freeze begins at 2067892790. Exception merge allowed until 2067894590 (30m grace).

oncall: I'll start monitoring at merge and watch the 95th p50 latency for 30m. If regressions >15% trigger rollback.

maria: Merged PR #6032 at 2067890305. changelog tagged. rollback plan ready.

devon: noted — will keep an eye on gpu-inference suite; will be ready to revert if oncall flags.

release-manager: Thanks all. Good example of exception workflow. If anything spikes, call the exec channel and we’ll revert.

alex: nice work, team.

maria: thanks!
